3.1 Language Focus: Uses of a.m. and p.m.
nine o'clock in the morning
one o'clock in the afternoon
half past six in the evening
ten o'clock at night

subject: English
text:
We use a.m. (ante meridiem) to show that the time between midnight
(12 o'clock at night) and noon (up to 11:59 at midday).
We use p.m. (post meridiem) to show that the time between noon
(12 o'clock at noon) and midnight (up to 11:59 at night).
